policy: Same byte-identical V4 initial prompt; one conditional execution repair for empty, truncated or unexecutable source. Final response only, no best-of or manual code edits. All completed reply tokens and provider-reported costs included.
routingPolicy: OpenRouter is the API intermediary. Each request fixes one named model and one exact upstream endpoint slug with fallbacks disabled; no model router, automatic model selection, Highspeed duplicate or substitute is allowed. Actual upstream name, returned model and canonical catalog version are retained.
costPolicy: Display actual OpenRouter usage.cost summed across all completed creative responses. Completion tokens already include reasoning; never add reasoning tokens a second time. All raw provider and wire evidence is retained privately. No key, account setting or credential is published.
